researchDraft.querySummary: Balanced cross-domain scan for 2026-10-04 using only the supplied independently indexed records. Corroborated pairs anchor a G7 emergency oil/diesel release and Spanish housing protests; single-publisher lanes that failed collection (energy-resources, urban-infrastructure, geopolitics-security, technology-ai at n=1) yielded no qualifying two-source candidates. Ten candidates span macro-finance/energy security, industry-trade, climate-environment, health-science, demographics-society, and institutions-culture. AI and conflict were each capped at one lane and ultimately produced no candidates because no two independent, clickable sources exist in the dossier; both were explicitly weighted as ordinary lanes, not privileged.

en.title: G7 to release up to 100m barrels of emergency oil and diesel reserves after a Trump threat
en.coreFact: The BBC reports the G7 will release millions of barrels of oil and diesel following a threat from Trump, while The Guardian reports the same decision framed as up to 100m barrels of emergency oil and diesel reserves.
en.whyItMatters: Coordinated release of strategic reserves is a structural escalation signal: it treats liquid-fuel supply as a geopolitical buffer rather than a purely market-priced commodity, tightening the link between energy access and strategic capacity.
en.processMatchReason: Directly reinforces process-energy-security, where reliable energy access increasingly determines where strategic capacity can grow; a G7 reserve release tests whether coordinated state inventories can absorb a politicized supply shock.

zh.title: 七国集团在特朗普威胁后释放最多1亿桶应急石油与柴油储备
zh.coreFact: BBC报道称，在特朗普发出威胁后，七国集团将释放数百万桶石油和柴油；《卫报》将同一决定表述为最多1亿桶应急石油和柴油储备。
zh.whyItMatters: 协调释放战略储备是结构性升级信号：它将液体燃料供应视为地缘政治缓冲，而非单纯由市场定价的商品，从而强化能源获取与战略能力之间的联系。
zh.processMatchReason: 直接强化‘能源安全’进程——可靠能源获取日益决定战略能力可增长的地点；七国集团释放储备检验协调性国家库存能否吸收被政治化的供应冲击。

en.title: Tens of thousands protest across Spain over the housing crisis as the right blocks housing plans
en.coreFact: The BBC and The Guardian both report tens of thousands protesting in Spain over the housing crisis, and The Guardian separately reports the Spanish right wing voting down housing crisis plans as the protest movement grows.
en.whyItMatters: A mass, cross-city housing mobilization combined with a parliamentary block marks housing affordability shifting from a local planning issue to a national political cleavage across Europe.
en.processMatchReason: No existing world process covers housing-affordability politics; this is a distinct demographic-and-society structural turn rather than a match to AI-infrastructure, energy, semiconductor or technology-control processes.

zh.title: 西班牙数万人抗议住房危机，右翼否决住房计划
zh.coreFact: BBC与《卫报》均报道西班牙数万人就住房危机举行抗议；《卫报》另报道西班牙右翼在抗议运动扩大之际否决了住房危机计划。
zh.whyItMatters: 大规模跨城市住房动员与议会阻挠相结合，标志着住房可负担性正从地方规划议题转变为欧洲范围内的国家政治分野。
zh.processMatchReason: 现有世界进程未涵盖住房可负担性政治；这是独立的人口与社会结构性转折，而非匹配AI基础设施、能源、半导体或技术控制进程。

en.title: Cornell rape case tests campus accountability, ketamine use and #MeToo's limits
en.coreFact: The Guardian reports sadness, cynicism and deep disappointment over the Cornell gang-rape case and a failure of #MeToo, and separately reports the case raising questions about rising ketamine use in sexual assaults; the BBC reports the accuser is 'under siege' online.
en.whyItMatters: The case shows that institutional accountability mechanisms and public discourse are failing to convert awareness into protection, while online harassment of accusers adds a new deterrent layer.
en.processMatchReason: No existing world process covers campus accountability or sexual-violence policy; this is a distinct institutions-and-demographics signal rather than a match to the AI-infrastructure, energy, semiconductor or technology-control processes.

zh.title: 康奈尔强奸案考验校园问责、氯胺酮使用与#MeToo的边界

zh.whyItMatters: 该案表明制度问责机制与公共话语未能把认知转化为保护，同时指控者遭受网络骚扰新增了一层威慑。
zh.processMatchReason: 现有世界进程未涵盖校园问责或性暴力政策；这是独立的制度与人口社会信号，而非匹配AI基础设施、能源、半导体或技术控制进程。
